#!/usr/bin/env bash
# vea-task-commit-wt.sh <worktree> <message> <paths...>

# node_modules symlinks). Husky hooks must work (`.husky/_` copied in).

MSG="${2:?usage: vea-task-commit-wt.sh <worktree> <message> <paths...>}"
shift 2
git -C "$WT" add -- "$@"
